name: creature_flow
description: The non-humanoid creature pipeline: concept image -> Pixal3D mesh -> quad remesh (50K) -> UltraShape refine -> optional anyCreature rig -> 8 turntable views. Humanoid creatures use humanoid-flow, NOT this pipeline. Composes the image and 3d cards internally. These lanes are AGENT-DRIVEN card chains (2026-09-04 flows rework): drive each stage card through the queue door ({model: ...}); there is no single-shot yaml door anymore (dev_docs/queue/flows.md).

prompt.description: Concept prompt when no image is supplied - flat background, full silhouette.

face_budget.description: Quad target for the remesh stage. Default 50000.

rig.description: Apply the anyCreature skeleton rig. Default true.
